block.label.note: the Sponsor block's label, always shown

block.waiting: The creative is due {due}. Until it arrives, this issue can't go out with the block.
fix.refreshed: Filled the Sponsor block from the booking
notify.creativeDueBody: {sponsor}'s creative for #{issue} is due tomorrow. Until it's marked ready, the issue can't go out with the Sponsor block.
notify.creativeLateBody: {sponsor}'s creative for #{issue} hasn't arrived. Until it's marked ready, Review & send won't let #{issue} go out with the Sponsor block.
notify.paymentBody: {sponsor}: {amount} for #{issue} was due on {date}. Record the payment when it arrives; ReputeCast doesn't send invoices or reminders to sponsors.
problem.bookingClosed: This booking was canceled or is still a proposal. Book the issue again instead.
problem.campaign: Pick a campaign of this workspace.
problem.cancelSent: Issue #{issue} already went out with this booking, so it can't be canceled. Record the payment, or leave a note.
problem.creativeIncomplete: Add a headline, text and link first.
problem.creativeLocked: The issue went out with this creative, so it can't change.
problem.holdBeforeIssue: A hold has to end before issue #{issue} goes out, and not in the past.
problem.holdDate: Pick the date the hold ends.
problem.imagesUnavailable: Uploads aren't available in this process. Try again in a moment.
problem.imageTooLarge: The image is larger than 5 MB, or the upload was interrupted. Try a smaller PNG or JPG.
problem.issuePast: Issue #{issue} has already gone out. Book an issue still to come.
problem.issueTaken: Issue #{issue} is already booked or on hold. Open its booking instead.
problem.link: Enter a web address starting with https://.
problem.nameTaken: A sponsor called {name} is already in the library.
problem.notProposed: This booking isn't a proposal any more. Reload the panel.
problem.notSentYet: Issue #{issue} hasn't gone out yet. Its report starts when it's sent.
problem.paidFuture: A payment can't be recorded for a date still to come.
problem.pickSponsor: Pick a sponsor from the library.
problem.readyNeedsBooking: Only a booked issue's creative can be marked ready.
problem.slotDate: Enter the date of the first numbered issue as YYYY-MM-DD.
problem.slotHasBookings: {name} has {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} booked or on hold. Cancel them first.
problem.slotList: Pick a list of this workspace.
problem.slotName: Name the slot, such as “Main sponsor”.
problem.sponsorHasBookings: {name} has {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} booked or on hold. Cancel them first, or keep the sponsor.
problem.utm: UTM parameters can't contain spaces, &, ?, # or =.
problem.website: Enter the sponsor's website, such as northwind-analytics.example.
shared.comingText: Results are final on {date}, 72 hours after sending. Until then the numbers can still go up.
shared.everyNote: Each issue counts only the recipients who got the block. Totals add up as issues go out.
shared.goneText: {publisher} revoked this link, or it expired. Ask your contact at {publisher} for a new one.
shared.howText: human opens leave out Apple Mail Privacy Protection prefetches and security scanners. Clicks by bots are left out. Results are final 72 hours after sending.
shared.linksGo: {count, plural, one {It goes} =2 {Both go} other {They all go}} to {host} with {utm}.
shared.linksGoNoUTM: {count, plural, one {It goes} =2 {Both go} other {They all go}} to {host}.
shared.rowClicks: {clickers, plural, one {# unique clicker} other {# unique clickers}} · {rate}
shared.shared: Shared by {publisher} · this link expires on {date}
shared.title: Sponsor report
